No. 2431/37 – FRIDAY, APRIL 11, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. : Bu/Ln/1/1/22. Min. of Lands Ref. No. : 3-43/2019/FR/165 I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:- Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: Boundaries are as follows for the land called, Idadeniya and Palagalamukalana extent of 0.8599 Hectare mentioned in Block No. 04, Sheet No. 02, Lot Number I in Cadastral Map No. 530426, Prepared by Surveyor General situated in Udugalakanda Village of Bulathsinghala Divisional Secretary's Division in Kalutara District, in Western Province.
Lot No. 01 - Idadeniya and Palagalamukalana - Extent: 0.8599 Hectare.

North: Lot No. 1936 of F.T.P. 03; East: Lot No. 1936 of F.T.P. 03; South: Lot No. 1936 of F.T.P. 03; West: Lot No. 1936 of F.T.P. 03. All persons interested in the aforesaid land on the which a servitude is to be acquired to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Bulathsinghala on 30th April, 2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the April 30th on the day of 2025, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. B. A. Sංඍඁൺඋං Uൽൺඒൺඇ඀ൺඇං, Acting Divisional Secretary, Bulathsinghala. 07th April, 2025, Divisional Secretariat, Bulathsinghala. EOG 04 - 0082

AMENDMENT THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: DSM/ML/LND/5/4-IV. Reference No. of the Land Ministry: 4-3/9/2013/HW/369. I hereby declared the Investigation date and Lot Numbers which was published in Page 5A in Gazette Extraordinary No. 222/50 and dated 08.04.2021, are changed as follows:- Lot No. 7 - First owner: D. V. G. K. De Silva was enjoyed unofficially, Assessment tax No. 7; Extent 0.0014 Hectare. North: Nagolla Road and Lot No. 6; East: Lot Nos. 6, 5 and 8; South: Lot Nos. 8, 10 and 9; West: Nagolla Road. Lot No. 8 - First owner: Does not the first owner D. V. G. K. De Silva was enjoyed unofficially, Assessment tax No. 7; Extent 0.0026 Hectare. North: Lot Nos. 7, 6 and 5; East: Lot No. 5 and Lot No. D 54 (OP 106758) of PP 1127; South: Lot No. D 54 (OP106758) of PP1127, Lot Nos. 10 and 9 of said plan; West: Lot No. 7. Therefore all persons who have rights or interested of the aforesaid land are hereby announced to appear personally, or by agent before me at 11.00 a.m. on 16th day of June 2025 at the Divisional Secretariat Matale. And further inform that, make me know in written document with two copies before on 09th day of June 2025 Regarding particulars of nature of their possession claims or compensation and how compensation was calculated. Proof of claim should be produced at the inquiry. B. P. Sൾඇൺൽඁൾൾඋൺ, Divisional Secretary, Matale. On 04th day of April, 2025, At Divisional Secretariat, Matale. EOG 04 - 0083
